column1: # A row names an in-scope theorem (ArmadaLean.Nitro.Safety.lean, PoolSafety.lean,
# ArmadaLean.Nitro.Liveness.lean) whose statement is universally quantified over its
# machine's state type with no Reachable* hypothesis, reviewed and found to hold for
# every value of that type, not only reachable ones. Two source audits, both dated
# the four can-happen theorems dropped -- PoolSafety.lean now states them over
# Pool.machine.Reachable, so they are REACH, not exempt) and
# take an Adjudicator E argument and so are in scope; the other 15 take none and are
# out of scope -- not listed here, per reach.py's own scope rule). Four Liveness.lean
# theorems hold for every Adjudicator E by the same review (reason: "reads no network
# state; one operation or arithmetic"); the other two Liveness theorems in that review
# take no Adjudicator E argument and are out of scope.

Hypothesis is `s.deposit c.address e x = some s'` directly; `Adjudicator.deposit` (`Adjudicator.lean:104-112`) is a pure match on `a`, so the conclusion follows from the definition for any `s`, reachable or not.
`simp [Adjudicator.deposit, hk]`: unfolds the deposit definition directly for any `s`; `hk : c.kind = .ledger` is an explicit premise, not a derived invariant.
Direct unfold of `Adjudicator.deposit`'s guard (`Adjudicator.lean:108`); holds for any `s`.
Hypothesis is `s.balances.get c.address = 0` for an arbitrary `s`, not `Reachable`; proved by `deposit_can_happen` (a universal fact) applied repeatedly by induction on `k`.
`rfl`: `Adjudicator.deposit` always returns `none` on `.external` (`Adjudicator.lean:112`); holds for every `s`.
Case split on `op`; deposit case derives a contradiction purely from `Adjudicator.deposit`'s effect on `balances.get` (always adds or leaves unchanged, `Adjudicator.lean:104-112`); no invariant used.

Hypothesis `h : Step apps s s'` only, no `Reachable`; each `Op` case is proved by unfolding `payTo`/`transfer`/`reclaim` (`Adjudicator.lean:119-203`), a deterministic syntactic effect true from any starting `s`.

Direct computation from `Adjudicator.transfer` (`Adjudicator.lean:140-152`) given its own preconditions (`ha`, `hbf`, `hf`, `hb`) as explicit hypotheses on an arbitrary `s`; true whether or not `s` is reachable.
By cases on `s.transfer a b`; the `some` branch is refuted purely from `Adjudicator.transfer_some`'s destructuring, for any `s`.

Hypotheses are `s.transfer a b = some s'` and a `paidTo = 0` side-condition on `s`, both explicit on an arbitrary `s`, not `Reachable`; the "operator ruling 2026-10-27" doc-comment note already explains the channel-kind guard is enforced inside `Adjudicator.transfer` itself, so no separate reachability hypothesis is needed.
Direct unfold of `Adjudicator.transfer`'s branch on `s.finalOutcome` (`Adjudicator.lean:143-144`); true for any `s`.
`transfer`/`reclaim` read no `caller` argument at all (`Adjudicator.lean:140-203`); true for any `s`, `c1`, `c2`.

A monotonicity helper on the `FinalizedTwoWays` predicate (`Safety.lean:504-509`), which already carries its own `Reachable apps s0` existential; the lemma itself needs no extra reachability hypothesis on `s`/`s'`, it only threads the one already inside `h`.
A transport lemma along `s'.statusOf c = s.statusOf c`; inherits whatever `StatusOrigin` fact `ho` already supplies, adds no new reachability assumption.
Same pattern as `statusOrigin_of_eq`: transports an existing `StatusOrigin` fact `ho` through a redistribution step; no independent reachability hypothesis.

Hypothesis `h : Step apps s s'`, no `Reachable`; every case unfolds `ChannelStatus.mode`'s guard logic (challenge/checkpoint/conclude all refuse a finalized channel, `Adjudicator.lean:215-254`), true from any starting `s`.
Hypothesis `h : Step apps s s'`, no `Reachable`; a structural fact about one step's effect on `finalOutcome`, proved case-by-case from the operation definitions, true from any `s`.
`exact (Adjudicator.challenge_some h).1`: direct unfold of `Adjudicator.challenge`'s guard (`Adjudicator.lean:215-223`); true for any `s`.
By cases, refuted from `Adjudicator.challenge`'s finalized-exclusion guard; true for any `s`.
Direct unfold of the turn-number guard in `Adjudicator.challenge`; true for any `s`.
`simp only [Adjudicator.challenge, if_pos …]`: exact computation from the definition given its own explicit preconditions; true for any `s`.
Direct destructuring of `Adjudicator.challenge_some h`; true for any `s`.
Direct unfold of `Adjudicator.checkpoint`'s guard (`Adjudicator.lean:232-239`); true for any `s`.
Exact computation from the definition given its own explicit preconditions; true for any `s`.

Hypothesis `h : Step apps s s'`, no `Reachable`; the disjunction's second disjunct already accounts for the one case (`conclude`) that can lower the stored turn, so the fact holds unconditionally from any `s` (the doc-comment's "operator ruling 2026-10-27" note documents that this except-clause was the fix, already present in the signature).
Direct unfold of `Adjudicator.conclude`'s guard (`Adjudicator.lean:249-254`); true for any `s`.

`Adjudicator.conclude` only writes `status` (`Adjudicator.lean:249-254`); true for any `s`.
Direct unfold of `ChannelStatus.mode`/`finalOutcome` on a `.challenged` status past its deadline; pure function of the given `s.statusOf c` value, true for any `s`.
Same pattern, before the deadline; true for any `s`.
`Adjudicator.tick` only writes `now` (`Adjudicator.lean:259-260`); `rfl` for any `s`.
`Adjudicator.applyAll` on a failed head op returns `s` unchanged by definition (`Adjudicator.lean:337-339`); true for any `s`.

Explicitly compares `s` against `{ s with balances := b }` for an *arbitrary* `b` (possibly describing a balances list no real history ever produces); the theorem's point is exactly that the dispute operations (`challenge`/`checkpoint`/`conclude`/`tick`) never read `balances`, so the comparison is sound and meaningful by construction, not vacuous.
Direct unfold of `Adjudicator.reclaim`'s guard (`Adjudicator.lean:187-203`); true for any `s`.

Hypotheses `hlr`, `hlv`, `hrv`, `hne`, `hdedup` are explicit premises on an arbitrary `s` (not derived from `Reachable`); the doc-comment names the exact counterexamples (a self-guaranteeing ledger, a duplicate `v` entry) these premises rule out, so the stated theorem is strictly more general than a `Reachable`-gated version and holds for any `s` meeting them.
Exact computation from the definition given its own explicit preconditions; true for any `s`.
By cases, refuted from `Adjudicator.reclaim`'s guard; true for any `s`.
Direct unfold of `Adjudicator.statusOf`'s default (`Adjudicator.lean:40-41`); true for any `s` (reachable or hand-built) whose `status` list omits `c`.

Case split on `op`; each non-deposit/non-redistribution case derives `s'.held = s.held` purely from the operation's definition (`challenge`/`checkpoint`/`conclude`/`tick` never write `held`); true for any `s`.
